opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell homes, Ruud speaking. How can I help?
opening.comment: The greeting gives both the agent's name and the company name, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Agent: Right, done, I've changed order 391827 to 22 Lindengracht.
verification.comment: The agent changed the order without confirming the caller's full name, and the order number was misquoted (caller said 91827), so verification was not done before changing account data.

understanding.quote: Agent: Wasn't it already sent out yesterday? I got an email saying despatch.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the address change request, but the caller's issue was not fully understood and the agent did not clearly address the caller's stated urgency or the sofa covers need.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: Yes, it was dispatched yesterday, but that does matter, the courier will go to the news address.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Address changes are only possible before dispatch, so the agent wrongly told the caller the courier would deliver to the new address after the order had already shipped.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Right, done, I've changed order 391827 to 22 Lindengracht.
process_compliance.comment: No hold or photo/dispute steps applied, but the agent did not follow the required verification step before changing the order, so process was not fully followed.

communication.quote: Agent: five. Give me the new address.
communication.comment: The caller said they were really stressed and it was urgent, but the agent did not acknowledge this, and the reply was abrupt and unclear.

closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else but closed abruptly without a polite sign-off or clear confirmation of next steps.
